summary: Added key-derived Idempotency-Key headers (pl-<op>-<sha1[:16]>) for transfers, refunds and holds, and up to 4 attempts with 1/2/4s or Retry-After waits via transport.sleep, per the current standard. Reversals send no key and, after a lost response or 5xx, read the transfer before resending; captures and GETs use the plain retry rules.
